newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian thief snatches Mexican minister's coat.
newsitem.headline: Colombian thief snatches Mexican minister's coat.

text.p: Mexican Foreign Minister Jose Angel Gurria gained a first-hand insight into Colombia's mushrooming crime levels when a thief stole his raincoat during an official visit to the country last week.

The brazen crook snatched the coat from the office of Gurria's Colombian counterpart, Maria Emma Mejia, while he was giving a press conference at the foreign ministry building in downtown Bogota on Thursday, the El Tiempo newspaper reported on Sunday.
The Mexican minister left the gabardine to dry out after he was caught in an unseasonal deluge.
During the press conference, Gurria condemned many U.S. legislators' description of Colombia as a haven of crime and corruption as "extremely perjorative." Gurria returned to Mexico on Friday.
